mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 7.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where UNRATE has exceeded 7.5% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 225) with rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 0.1%), the market prices in a prolonged monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months signals weakening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate policy easing.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 760,000 units, it signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of instances where HOUST exceeds 760,000, or the Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a strong labor market, causing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime (INDPRO < 95), the market reacts to production disruptions by selling equities, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO is below 95, or the Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.03.
